remarks: Beautiful, spacious 2-3 bedroom townhouse in Greenwich. Gourmet kitchen with large pantry, stainless appliances, granite counters and center island. 2 full and 2 half baths, living room with high ceilings and gas fireplace and recessed lighting. Upstairs laundry, generous primary with walk-in closet, high ceilings, recessed lighting, full on-suite bath with marble, separate shower and whirpool tub. his and her sinks. 2nd upstairs bedroom also has an on-suite bath with newer marble counter and shower stall. Entry level has wide foyer, den and office or 3rd bedroom with lots of storage. The attached garage has auto-door opener. Conveniently located to town and all amenities. Must see to appreciate!
